assumptions: Appropriateness is phase-dependent: information gathering early, result review mid-episode, definitive intervention late.

Repeating the immediately preceding action incurs a redundancy penalty.
Terminal bonus/penalty reflects the synthetic disposition label only; it is not a validated outcome measure.
Reward components are reported per step so the weighting can be re-tuned offline without regenerating the dataset.

assumptions: Appropriateness is phase-dependent: information gathering early, result review mid-episode, definitive intervention late.
Stabilization reward is proportional to the reduction of a latent severity index in [0,1], scaled by 4 and clipped to [-1,1].
Harm is incurred when the agent delays definitive action on a severely unstable patient (severity > 0.75).
Delay penalty is incurred when severity > 0.60 and the chosen action is non-definitive (OBSERVATION / ORDER_LAB_TEST / CLINICAL_REVIEW).
Repeating the immediately preceding action incurs a redundancy penalty.
Terminal bonus/penalty reflects the synthetic disposition label only; it is not a validated outcome measure.
Reward components are reported per step so the weighting can be re-tuned offline without regenerating the dataset.

Stabilization reward is proportional to the reduction of a latent severity index in [0,1], scaled by 4 and clipped to [-1,1].
Harm is incurred when the agent delays definitive action on a severely unstable patient (severity > 0.75).
Delay penalty is incurred when severity > 0.60 and the chosen action is non-definitive (OBSERVATION / ORDER_LAB_TEST / CLINICAL_REVIEW).
Repeating the immediately preceding action incurs a redundancy penalty.
Terminal bonus/penalty reflects the synthetic disposition label only; it is not a validated outcome measure.
Reward components are reported per step so the weighting can be re-tuned offline without regenerating the dataset.

assumptions: Appropriateness is phase-dependent: information gathering early, result review mid-episode, definitive intervention late.

Repeating the immediately preceding action incurs a redundancy penalty.
Terminal bonus/penalty reflects the synthetic disposition label only; it is not a validated outcome measure.
Reward components are reported per step so the weighting can be re-tuned offline without regenerating the dataset.

assumptions: Appropriateness is phase-dependent: information gathering early, result review mid-episode, definitive intervention late.
Stabilization reward is proportional to the reduction of a latent severity index in [0,1], scaled by 4 and clipped to [-1,1].
Harm is incurred when the agent delays definitive action on a severely unstable patient (severity > 0.75).
Delay penalty is incurred when severity > 0.60 and the chosen action is non-definitive (OBSERVATION / ORDER_LAB_TEST / CLINICAL_REVIEW).
Repeating the immediately preceding action incurs a redundancy penalty.
Terminal bonus/penalty reflects the synthetic disposition label only; it is not a validated outcome measure.
Reward components are reported per step so the weighting can be re-tuned offline without regenerating the dataset.
